label: D1 step when the agent leans toward choosing a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2), on about a third of D1 steps. Activity follows the agent policy leaning toward a1: 83% of mass is on trials where the upcoming choice is a1, and the D1 policy logit(a1)-logit(a2) in roughly [2.8, 8] holds 78% of mass. It is silent when the a1 preference is extreme (logit > 8.07) and when value is high (> 7.73), so it fires on moderate rather than saturated a1 commitment. Recorded the observed predicate D1 & choice > 1.5 (dev F1 0.69, mass recall 0.90). The future-action version D1 & action == 1 is about the same (F1 0.67, mass recall 0.83). The model-based rule computed from observed history scores much worse (F1 0.45). Magnitude: activations after an unrewarded previous trial (r0 at D1) are larger per step; they hold 47% of mass from 37% of activations, and the top windows are mostly r0 D1 steps before an a1 choice. Precision is only about 0.6: many D1 steps with an a1 lean stay silent.
